metadata.basis: OpenStreetMap spaceport feature, reduced to a point.
metadata.note: A launch site is not a launch. No schedule, vehicle, payload, operator or readiness is implied, and the registry is crowd-sourced.
metadata.extraction: Coordinates taken from the Overpass response; nodes as published and areas as the centroid OpenStreetMap publishes for them. No coordinate created or moved.
